summary.deduplication: First protocol-listed representation for each source SHA256, fixed before observing outcomes. All named duplicates remain in detailed tables.
summary.policy_metric: Three repetitions averaged within each canonical eligible source, then equally weighted across sources. Failed/missing campaigns retain the certified baseline as delivered zero improvement; their candidate measurements remain unavailable.
summary.native_scope: Descriptive configurations, grouped by clock family. June and Compact have different native hold constraints (10 tiles/30% steps versus 4 tiles), so their comparison is not a same-constraint causal test. Policy comparisons keep the exact paired backend and its rules.
